generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Fires an entity event on the shooter, the projectile, the entity hit, and/or all entities in a splash radius.

fields.title: Affect Projectile
fields.description: If `true`, the event is fired on the projectile entity itself.

fields.title: Affect Shooter
fields.description: If `true`, the event is fired on the projectile's shooter.

fields.title: Affect Splash Area
fields.description: If `true`, the event is fired on every entity within `splash_area` blocks of the impact.

fields.title: Affect Target
fields.description: If `true`, the event is fired on the entity hit by the projectile.

fields.title: Event Trigger
fields.description: Event trigger (with optional filters) to fire on the selected target(s).
